Advanced: enable fetching

Load the compiled plugins when starting the service. Build the bundled plugins as described in the setup guide, then run from the repository root:

cargo run --locked -p paperphase -- serve --connector-bindings plugins/bindings.example.json

For live data, omit --now; that option fixes the clock for tests. Other plugins need their own registration file.

A display with your day on it.

Paperphase helps you arrange useful information on an e-paper display. Keep a weather forecast, a few headlines or your next appointment in view.
